title: move
description: The joystick: pan, tilt and zoom at these speeds, -1 to 1, for 300 ms. Call it again every 100 ms or so while the stick is held; when the calls stop the camera stops by itself, so a closed tab never leaves a camera turning. While it is held the follow loop's speeds are ignored.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera's id. May be left out when there is only one camera.
